game.name: Musou Orochi 2
game.desc: Warriors Orochi 3 Ultimate is an enhanced version of the hit action game Warriors Orochi 3, once again combining the much loved heroes of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. The mythology of the Orochi universe expands with a new main storyline, which brings the heroes together again into the chaos of battle as they are summoned upon by a mysterious stone. The adventure is complemented by side stories offering over 175 scenarios and endings to uncover, including the ability to battle from the point of view of various characters and even "what if" hypothetical stages that exist in a parallel world.
